name: Beacon
description: Checks the page in a browser or the screen of a device against the rules of your Beacon account, and keeps a report in Output.

permissions.browser.control: Reads the page of a browser you check, and takes a picture of it
permissions.devices.control: Reads the state of a device you check, and takes a picture of its screen
permissions.agents.run: Asks one of your agents to sum up the findings
permissions.chats.send: Sends the last report to a chat when you ask
permissions.database.read: Checks that the databases of the project answer
